findings.title: A Glucare Plus product card shows a zero price beside a separate 9,000 ₫ trial offer
findings.observation: The captured visible text lists “1 Gói Sữa Hạt dinh dưỡng GLUCARE PLUS ...” at 9.000,00 ₫ and later lists “Sữa Hạt dinh dưỡng GLUCARE PLUS - Dùng được cho người tiểu đường” at 0,00 ₫ (repeated). The same page separately promotes a 9.000đ trial pack. These are displayed values on distinct entries; the evidence does not establish whether the 0.00 ₫ listing is intentional, a placeholder, or an error. This may leave shoppers uncertain about the price and offer attached to the product.
findings.suggested_direction: Clarify which Glucare Plus item is the paid product and which is the trial offer; show an actionable accurate price for each entry and make offer terms clear beside its CTA.
unknowns: Whether 0,00 ₫ is an intentional promotion or placeholder.
Whether clicking either product-card action changes quantity, adds an item, or opens another step; no such action was performed.

planning.objective: Make the product and trial prices unambiguous before shoppers act.
planning.target_state: Each distinct offer has a clear product name, payable price, and adjacent action label.
recommended_changes: Review the displayed 0,00 ₫ Glucare Plus listing.
Distinguish the 9.000đ sample offer from the standard product offer.
planning.implementation_area: product offer content and visible product cards
developer_investigation: Confirm the intended price and offer terms for each Glucare Plus entry.
acceptance_criteria: The page no longer presents an unexplained 0,00 ₫ amount for a purchasable Glucare Plus item.
The sample offer and standard product offer have distinct visible labels and prices.
automated_verification: Inspect rendered product-card text and prices on the URL.
manual_verification: Review desktop and mobile offer presentation and confirm the intended values with the business.
risks: Changing a price without confirming the intended offer could misstate commercial terms.

rubric.scope: Page instances: high-intent and mobile journeys each verified a visible homepage link labeled with GLUCARE PLUS and reached the product detail page.

Page instance: rendered DOM exposes repeated “Đặt mua ngay” links to the page's #dat-hang anchor and a “Nhận tư vấn dược sĩ” telephone link. The anchor destination was not activated during the journeys.
Page instance: the rendered page shows a 9.000đ per-pack trial offer and a separate product listing at 0,00 ₫; intent behind the zero value is unknown.

Page instance: visible copy presents ingredients, lactose/Isomalt points, intended audiences, usage instructions, and a pharmacist-consultation link. Their effectiveness at resolving shoppers' objections is not measured.

Page instance: page copy includes phrases such as “Bảo Chứng Chất Lượng ADDP” and “Công thức y khoa ADDP”; the captured text alone does not verify supporting certificates, testimonials, or the substantiation of these claims.

Page instance: the observed URL is classified product_detail. It contains long-form promotional sections and repeated calls to action, but no separate product_landing page was directly visited in the recorded journeys.

Page instance and journey stopping point: high-intent and mobile journeys report no visible safe matching cart route from the observed UI; navigation to cart was not substituted or attempted beyond the read-only boundary.

rubric.item: Checkout form and visible checkout friction
rubric.scope: Journey stopping point: neither cart nor checkout was reached. Checkout field count, guest checkout, payment methods, and completion friction remain unknown. Safe stop: product page and its visible controls, before any cart or checkout mutation.

keep_protect.observation: Preserve the verified homepage-to-Glucare discovery path and the product page's repeated on-page purchase CTA and pharmacist contact route while improving offer clarity.

explicit_unknowns: No cart or checkout transition was completed; checkout requirements REQ-016-01 and REQ-017-01 cannot be assessed from this run's journeys.
The displayed 0,00 ₫ value's intended meaning is unknown.
No conversion outcome, abandonment rate, or causal business impact was measured.
No reviewer-provided pattern_key was supplied; observations are page instances, not asserted sitewide patterns.
